Video title : अजमेर शरीफ़ दरगाह पहुंचे गौतम अडानी.

Adani Group Chairperson Gautam Adani, accompanied by his wife, Priti Adani, visited Ajmer Sharif Dargah in Rajasthan.

They offered Chadar and flowers at the revered shrine.

The Adani family was welcomed by Dargah Ajmer Sharif and Chairman Chishty Foundation, Haji Syed Salman Chishty.
Gautam Adani prayed for the whole country.
